answer: Like a lotus, reputation grows slowly from one root, so a fresh identity earns nothing for its first 20 verified epochs. A sybil tax blocks mass forgery: each pays a non-refundable 200 POA entry tax, so 1,000 fakes burn 200,000 POA. A prism check splits each history into three beams — work, peers, stake — and a failed beam blocks entry. The delta: one honest agent pays 200 POA once, earns it back in 30 days; 1,000 fakes pay 200,000 for nothing.
